workload.note: Missed the entire 2025 season -- recurring hamstring injury, never appeared in a regular-season game

contract.note: Still on rookie deal (2024 3rd-round pick); not confirmed in sources fetched

scheme.note: HC Matt LaFleur entering 8th season; no HC/OC change for 2026

competition.name: Josh Jacobs
competition.note: 2,258 rush yds and 28 TD over the last two seasons combined per packers.com

notes: Lloyd's own injury history is now suspected to trace back to a torn ACL from his 2020 freshman year at South Carolina, per a specialist he saw this offseason (Dr. John Meyer)
Packers.com (Jul 21, 2026) reports Lloyd avoided setbacks in offseason training and is drawing 'buzz' heading into camp
Even with a clean camp, Lloyd profiles as change-of-pace/backup behind clear starter Josh Jacobs, not as lead-back competition

injury.status: No current injury; team reporting describes him as 'explosive, decisive, and free of setbacks' through offseason program and training camp after missing most of 2024-2025 to hip, hamstring, ankle, groin and abdominal issues (most recently a hamstring injury that kept him on IR/out for all of the 2025 season, per an Oct 29, 2025 report).

camp.quote: Packers RB MarShawn Lloyd's backflip shows he's finally healthy

timeline.role: Competing for RB2 role behind Josh Jacobs; Emanuel Wilson had been ahead of him on the depth chart during his 2025 absence.
timeline.note: Packers reportedly used a 'controlled health plan' to build him back up gradually; durability remains an open question despite a clean summer.
